author: shaamad
text:
📢 UnitedHealth Group Cybersecurity Info Session: TODAY!

UnitedHealth Group is hosting a free virtual info session today, Thursday, Nov 5, from 5 to 6 PM ET about their summer cybersecurity internships and their full-time Cybersecurity Development Program (CsDP). It’s open to the public!

The CsDP is a rotational program where you work across areas like incident response, EDR, threat intel, vulnerability management, and security automation.

The job postings are live now, so this is a great chance to learn about the roles, ask questions, and get your name in front of the team before you apply.

⏰ It wraps up right at 6, just in time for our meeting with Rod at 6 PM, so you can catch both!

🔗 Register here: https://lnkd.in/eApVtUec

See you there! 💻
